note: Per-scene facts for the agent and for check-video.js. Slot names and word limits must match each scene's registered `slots` (tests/scenes.test.js holds them in step). `shapes` lists the story structures; the world is always the page's own, and `verified` marks a shape whose acceptance video has passed.

swap.note: the one transition: the words leave, the shared frame swaps its words, the next words rise in

travel.note: the same swap with a longer quiet stretch while the world acts; its length is the beat's stage.wait (1.4 s by default when story time changes)

lineup.job: a cast on one stage, re-arranged per dimension

assembly.job: a thing built up step by step, cutaways as staged inserts

episodes.job: a place per item, the camera travels between them

journey.job: a schematic map stage for routes, campaigns and migrations

beat.job: one finding in the card, over the stage
beat.data: chart?: { kind: bars | line }; stage: { shows, time?, focus?, zoom?, look?, wait? }

source-card.job: every source with its date; the stage keeps moving
